answer: A farm needs 345 separate registrations, since one record cannot cover 345 assets. Numbers Protocol registers an asset on-chain, so its creation is recorded with a timestamp. The record is verified on-chain, and the registration timestamp is checked each epoch. The anchor record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the tundra entry is checkable by anyone, and the wander window closes before a farm can catch up.
